title: Structured deferred-capability closure declaration
description: The only closure artifact STEP2 reads for newly introduced deferred capabilities. Instance path: governance/gates/{gateId}/state/revisions/{stateRevision}/DEFERRED_CAPABILITY_DECLARATION.json. An empty array is an explicit claim that this closure introduces none. Arbitrary prose elsewhere is irrelevant. additionalProperties is false so undeclared fields cannot smuggle meaning.

deferredCapabilitiesIntroduced.description: Explicit list of DeferredCapabilityId values this closure newly introduces or restates as still-deferred. [] is valid.
